notes: Group chats you can actually make. The + button now asks whether you want a character or a group, and a group is a name and a list of people you tick. Everyone in one reads the whole thread — including what the others said — and now remembers it afterwards whether or not they spoke, which was the real gap: only the characters who happened to answer were learning anything, so a member sitting quietly through a conversation forgot it entirely. Who replies is decided by who you spoke to: names and relationships are recognised, including the words people actually use for them, so 'mum, can we talk' reaches your mother and 'hey harper' reaches Harper without anyone else interrupting. Members can be changed later from the menu inside the chat.
